description: This file defines the IterateMap class, which implements a method operation for the mini-language of the Apache OFBiz framework. It iterates over entries of a map, executing sub-operations for each key-value pair, and supports control flow statements like break and continue.

classes.name: IterateMap
classes.description: Implements the <iterate-map> element for the mini-language, iterates over a map and executes sub-operations for each key-value pair, with support for break and continue.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the iteration over the specified map, updating environment variables for each entry, and executing sub-operations.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from sub-operations for analysis or documentation.
